lines.en: I was going to put you down myself, but then I think you made mom a little angry.
lines.zh: 我本来想亲手宰了你，但我又想到，你稍稍惹恼了这位母亲。

lines.en: You people don't understand...  That cult...  They are insane!!  You know they think their god is coming back to rule this world?! I had no choice... I had no choice!!  Everything that transpired was of their design... my only desire was to become the legitimate Emperor...
lines.zh: 你们这些人不懂…… 那个邪教…… 他们都疯了！！ ！他们觉得他们的神会回来统治这个世界，你知道吗？！我别无选择……我别无选择！ 一切都是他们安排的……我想要的只是做个合法皇帝……
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: Unngggh....  Spare my life, please, Protagonist...
lines.zh: 呃啊啊…… 求求你，不要杀我，Protagonist……
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en:
Relax, it's only a flesh wound. You'll be wide awake for what's coming.
Goodbye, Casamir.  Give my regards to... whatever god tortures you in the afterlife.
Aggh!! W-what... no, I don't believe it! I can't!
lines.zh: 呃啊！！什、什么……不，我不相信！我不能！
lines.name: 卡西米尔
